{{Quote|Saleucami? But intelligence reported Grievous has no ships near that sector.|[[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], to her fellow [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]|<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>}}
The '''Suolriep sector''',<ref name="EAOC" /> also know as the '''Sulorine sector''', was a desolate [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was adjacent to [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]], the [[Divis Arm/Legends|Divis Arm]] and the [[Karstaxon Regions]]. Some notable [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in this sector were [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]], [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], [[Chaasch]], and [[Sulorine/Legends|Sulorine]], along with a few dozen lesser inhabited [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].

==History==
The [[Suolriep Sector Group]] patrolled the area during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

Suolriep sector's light traffic made it attractive to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and they located their [[Delta Base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[New Kisge]] orbiting [[Chaasch]].

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Rebel Alliance's [[Eclipse Team]] operated on Suolriep sector.<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Due to an editing error in ''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]'', what was formerly called the "Suolriep sector" by both the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] and ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' was consistently misprinted as the "Sulorine sector." [[Leland Chee]] had initially indicated that [[Lucasfilm]] would not be using the "Sulorine" spelling in the future but later reversed his position.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=158725&start=120#12150567|thread=Spelling Discrepancies|int=StarWars.com Message Boards|author=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2005-08-03|time=12:46 PM|quote=We have no intentions of using the Sulorine spelling in the future.}}</ref> Use of the "Sulorine" spelling has once again been discontinued with the publishing of the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion]]''. The ''Essential Atlas'' Online Companion's sector map of the Outer Rim included the sector, spelling it "Suolriep." No mention of "Sulorine sector" is made. This has resulted in ''Secrets of the Sisar Run'' being the only source to inconsistently misspell the sector name.

With regard to the the Suolriep/Sulorine spelling discrepancies, in the novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], [[Jason Fry]] noted that the planet [[Sulorine/Legends|Sulorine]] was a typo of "Suolriep"; however, it was decided to "let it exist."<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30387023|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-28|time=11:05 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180225165344/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-109}}</ref> This has led to the establishment of the planet [[Sulorine/Legends|Sulorine]] in the [[Sulorine system/Legends|Sulorine system]]. Unlike ''Secrets of the Sisar Run'', however, ''Outbound Flight'' makes no mention of a "Sulorine sector."
